checks: Setup detects the mocked hosted base and enables download after simulated asset checks.
Download action creates correctly named XML with the same ID, ReadItem, pinning, and complete hosted asset paths.
Setup layout fits 320 pixels without horizontal overflow.
Query and fragment on the setup page do not leak into generated resource addresses.
A missing asset disables download and identifies the missing file.
A localhost setup address is rejected with an actionable error.
No browser JavaScript exceptions in the offline DOM tests.
scope: Offline DOM tests in Chromium about:blank using in-memory production JS, a mocked address, and mocked fetch. Download bytes were inspected, not saved by a real browser download. No external hosting or Outlook integration verified.
